title: Reaction Rumble — Chemical Reactions
author: Dr. Dan
description: Reaction Rumble: balance equations, predict products, and write complete and net ionic equations, with a CHEM 3A / CHEM 1A course switch (3A gets Beginner, Intermediate and Champion levels). 222 reactions with a live atom counter, an animated particle view (spectator ions, precipitates, gases), tutor-style feedback on common mistakes, and a 60-second Blitz Challenge with 9 decks: reaction types, solubility, activity series, what drives a double displacement, Mix it! (named solutions), spot the spectator, balanced or not, true/false concepts, and a mixed bag. New: no-reaction problems and a "does it react?" check in Predict and Net Ionic, a Formulas/Names switch for reactants (Names by default in CHEM 1A), and Skill Check Prep with weak-spot tracking. Includes the Green Sheet, XP, achievements, and Dr. Dan's Chapter 10 and solubility videos.
